name: logisim-evolution
description: Design and verify Logisim Evolution circuits through a local, native-backed MCP server.

interface.longDescription: A local circuit-engineering plugin for Logisim Evolution. It compiles Boolean designs, creates hierarchical projects, inspects existing .circ files, writes test vectors, runs native simulations, and opens validated projects for visual QA.
defaultPrompt: Design and verify a Logisim circuit for me.
Inspect this .circ file and find wiring errors.
Build test vectors for my sequential circuit.
